title: Hazel and the Protocol
author: Casper Ravensworth
blurb: Sable Zhou, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
